channel.title: Cohesity incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Cohesity's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Microsoft Issue May have impacted M365 workloads (CCS) [resolved]
item.description:
We have been made aware of an issue on the Microsoft side of degradation of services which are impacting CCS workloads. Our understanding is that they have remediated the issue and things should be corrected. If you continue to experience problems, please contact Cohesity Support.
More information can be found at: https://status.cloud.microsoft/m365/referrer=serviceStatusRedirect

item.title: Intermittent issue impacting OneDrive and Mailbox workloads in CCS. [identified]
item.description: We are currently investigating an intermittent issue impacting certain Microsoft 365 backup jobs (OneDrive and mailbox workloads). Some objects may temporarily be reported as Unprotected, and new backup jobs may be temporarily unable to run. Please be assured this is not attributable to any action on your part; our team has identified the root cause and is implementing a fix. We will provide further updates as they become available.

item.title: Data Processing Delays - Activity Page and Reports Affected [resolved]
item.description: The Activity Page and Reports on the Helios platform should be fully functional with no lag now.

item.title: Customer Action Needed - Migrate to Certificate Based Authentication (CBA) [investigating]
item.description:
We are reissuing this incident statement as Microsoft has recently made the change and we have seen many tenants that have not migrated. Below is the original incident language that was sent in February 2026.
Cohesity is issuing this advisory to inform our Cloud Protection Service (CPS) customers of an important change regarding authentication for Microsoft 365 workflows. Microsoft is retiring Azure Access Control Service (ACS), effective April 2, 2026. Currently, ACS is utilized for authentication in certain Microsoft 365 workflows, including backups for SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Groups.
